## Step 8: AML Re-Screening (If Required)  
### When to Perform Full AML Screening  
**Mandatory Screening If:**
- Customer moving to new country (not just new city)
- New country is on OFAC/EU/HMT/UN sanctions list
- Customer flagged as medium/high risk
- Compliance Head requires it
- Address is in jurisdictions: Iran, Syria, North Korea, Cuba, etc.  
**Optional Screening If:**
- Customer moving within UK
- Low-risk customer
- Existing banking history >5 years with no issues

raw_entities.name: AML Re-Screening Process
raw_entities.description: A conditional anti-money laundering re-screening procedure triggered when customers move to new countries, are flagged as medium/high risk, or relocate to sanctioned jurisdictions. The process determines whether full AML screening is mandatory or optional based on customer risk profile, destination country status, and compliance requirements.

raw_entities.description: Evaluation step to determine if AML screening can be waived or deferred based on customer moving within UK, low-risk classification, or established banking history exceeding 5 years without compliance issues.
context: Optional Screening If: Customer moving within UK

Optional Screening If: Customer moving within UK
